d: Lok aastha ka mahaparv chhath najdik hai. 15 navanbar ko chhath mahaparv ka pahla arghy diya jaega, lekin ramgarh shahar ke pramukh damodar nadi chhath ghat ki tasvir abhi bhi chintajnak bani huee hai. ghat ke aaspas gandgi ka anbar laga hai. shahar ke nalon ka ganda pani khule taur par damodar nadi men gir raha hai, jisse pure ilake men badbu phail rahi hai. vahin, is bar barish ke karan nadi ka jalastar barhne aur nadi ke svarup men badlav se chhath vratiyon aur shraddhaluon ki mushkilen bhi barh gaee hain.
